data.resume_markdown:
# Abdul Rahaman S  
Machine Learning Engineer | Data Scientist  
abdulabd1132000@gmail.com  
8939030306  
Chennai  
[linkedin.com/in/abdul-rahaman-s11](https://linkedin.com/in/abdul-rahaman-s11)  
[github.com/11abd](https://github.com/11abd)  

## Summary  
Data Scientist and Machine Learning Engineer with a solid foundation in computer science and extensive experience in developing and deploying machine learning models. Proficient in designing end-to-end ML solutions, with a focus on deep learning, natural language processing (NLP), and model evaluation. Proven track record of enhancing model performance and explainability in production environments, actively transitioning into a dedicated ML engineering role.

## Skills  
**Languages:**  
Python, SQL  

**Deep Learning & NLP:**  
TensorFlow, Keras, Transformers, LLM, RAG  

**MLOps & Deployment:**  
MLflow, DVC, Docker, GitHub Actions, FastAPI, CI/CD  

**Cloud & Systems:**  
AWS (S3, EC2, SageMaker), Azure (AZ-900, AZ-104), Git, PostgreSQL  

**Machine Learning & Data Science:**  
Scikit-learn, XGBoost, Pandas, NumPy, Model Evaluation, Feature Engineering  

## Projects  
**Fraud Detection System – End-to-End MLOps Project**  
Technologies: Python, XGBoost, Scikit-learn, FastAPI, MLflow, Docker, GitHub Actions, SHAP  
- Developed an XGBoost-based fraud classifier on highly imbalanced transaction data (~0.17% fraud rate), significantly improving fraud recall compared to baseline models.  
- Implemented business-driven threshold tuning, enhancing recall-precision balance beyond default probability thresholds.  
- Achieved high ROC-AUC scores in the 0.9s while prioritizing recall for fraud detection use cases.  
- Integrated SHAP for model explainability, providing insights into feature importance for both global trends and individual predictions.  
- Deployed a FastAPI inference service, containerized with Docker, featuring automated CI checks and experiment tracking via MLflow.  

**RAG Chatbot (NLP / LLM Project)**  
Technologies: Python, FastAPI, Ollama, Sentence-transformers, ChromaDB  
- Created a fully offline RAG system to answer queries based on PDFs and lecture videos.  
- Implemented hybrid retrieval using vector similarity (ChromaDB) and keyword-based scoring for improved answer relevance.  
- Developed an idempotent ingestion pipeline for PDF parsing, Whisper-based transcription, chunking, and embeddings.  
- Integrated local LLM inference (Ollama) with strict context enforcement, reducing hallucinations and enhancing answer accuracy.  

## Professional Experience  
**Ciklum (Pixellot AI Sports Production)**  
Support Engineer  
Mar 2024 – Present | Chennai  
- Supported a large-scale sports production platform utilized by globally distributed B2B clients.  
- Monitored system and stream health using Grafana dashboards, proactively identifying anomalies to prevent downstream failures.  
- Diagnosed pipeline failures, data inconsistencies, and configuration issues through application and system log analysis.  
- Conducted acceptance testing for new installations, ensuring system stability prior to client handover.  
- Escalated recurring and critical issues to R&D teams with detailed reproduction steps and logs, contributing to long-term system reliability.  
- Gained exposure to production systems and algorithm behavior, motivating a deeper focus on machine learning and applied AI development.  

**Infosys**  
System Engineer  
Oct 2020 – Mar 2024 | Chennai  
- Resolved Windows OS and enterprise application incidents within SLA using ServiceNow.  
- Performed patching, vulnerability remediation, and system administration across servers and workstations.  
- Supported Office 365 services, including Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, and SharePoint.  
- Contributed to operational improvements through proactive monitoring and issue prevention.  

## Certifications  
- AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer – Associate (MLA-C01)  
- ITIL V4 Foundation – Service Management Best Practices  
- Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104)  
- Business Communication Excellence – Level 5  
- Microsoft Certified: Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900)  

## Education  
**University of Madras**  
Bachelor of Computer Applications  
2017 – 2020 | Chennai, India  

**Dhanalakshmi School**  
Higher Secondary  
2017 | Chennai

data.verdict: Good but needs meaningful gaps addressed
data.strengths: Strong technical skills in machine learning and deployment; relevant project experience showcasing practical application of skills; good use of industry-standard tools and technologies.
data.risks: Some experience listed may not directly relate to machine learning roles, which could raise questions about relevance; potential overemphasis on support roles without clear transition to ML engineering.
data.improvements: Focus on highlighting direct ML engineering experience; clarify the transition from support roles to ML engineering; ensure projects are framed to emphasize impact and relevance to the target role; consider restructuring for better clarity and emphasis on key achievements.
data.feedback: The resume presents a solid foundation for a Machine Learning Engineer role, with relevant skills and projects. However, it needs to better emphasize direct experience in ML engineering and clarify the transition from support roles. Streamlining the content to focus on impactful contributions and aligning more closely with the target role will enhance its effectiveness.
